title: Respect the safe screen area
summary: Some screens have cutouts or system bars.
introduction: Some screens have cutouts or system bars. Your task: Inspect the screen near the top system bar.
learningObjectives: Inspect the screen near the top system bar.
Explain the example for respect the safe screen area

blocks.text: Some screens have cutouts or system bars. Safe-area components add space so important content does not sit under those areas.
Use a current Expo project with React Native. Put examples in App.jsx. Run the project with Expo on a supported device or emulator. Native components do not run in this website's HTML playground.

blocks.title: Respect the safe screen area

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `SafeAreaView` from safe-area-context applies device insets so content avoids system bars and cutouts.

blocks.text: On a supported device, the content stays inside the safe area.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Install the Expo-compatible safe-area-context package. Test a real device shape rather than guessing a fixed top margin.

blocks.text: Inspect the screen near the top system bar.
